verdict.rationale: Resend supports multiple verified domains per account, each with its own DKIM keys. API keys can be restricted to sending_access for one specific domain, which gives a form of per-tenant credential isolation via multiple domains. A suppression list API exists, but nothing shows it can be scoped per domain or tenant, and dedicated-IP warmup is not shown to separate reputation per tenant. Missing for 10: subaccount/subuser constructs, per-tenant suppression lists, per-tenant reputation isolation (e.g., per-tenant IP pools), independent corroboration of multi-tenant use.
